abort.single_instance_allowed: Reolink Viewer is already set up.

user.description: Adds a Reolink sidebar panel for the cameras, NVRs and Home Hubs set up in the Reolink integration. Nothing else needs to be configured.
user.title: Reolink Viewer

reolink_incompatible.description:
Reolink Viewer could not use the Reolink integration's internals, which changed in this Home Assistant release: {errors}

The Reolink panel still lists your devices from the device registry, but the hardware probe is disabled. Update Reolink Viewer, or report the error at the project's issue tracker.
reolink_incompatible.title: Reolink Viewer is running in degraded mode
